necessary_context.content: At round t, choose X_t in D_t subset R^d, then observe Y_t=<X_t,theta_*>+eta_t. For the concentration statements, X_t is F_{t-1}-measurable and eta_t is F_t-measurable, with E[exp(u eta_t)|F_{t-1}]<=exp(u^2 R^2/2) for every real u. Theorem 1 permits R>=0.
necessary_context.name: Sequential observation model

necessary_context.content: Theorem 2 sets V=lambda I with lambda>0, assumes ||theta_*||_2<=S and defines the ridge estimator by equation (1). Its first radius is R sqrt(2 log(det(Vbar_t)^(1/2) det(lambda I)^(-1/2)/delta))+sqrt(lambda)S, where Vbar_t=lambda I+sum_{s=1}^t X_s X_s^T. It asserts simultaneous containment for all t>=0. The additional printed radius requires ||X_t||_2<=L for all t>=1; its normalization remains a use restriction rather than a repaired theorem.
necessary_context.name: Confidence ellipsoid definitions
